Ava / Ben — quick guidance:

1) Audit period acceptability: our standard is to have the most recent Type II report end date within 90 days of our review date OR a signed bridge letter from the auditor (or management+auditor confirmation) that affirms unchanged control effectiveness for the gap period. Since Clarion's report ends 2024-12-31 and today's date is 2026-05-30, that's outside the 90-day window — we should request a bridge letter.

2) Bridge letter minimum ask (one-paragraph template):
- Statement that the auditor performed no material changes in the design or operation of controls since the report period end (2024-12-31) through [current date], or confirmation of residual exceptions and remediation status.
- Auditor name, report period, and signature/date.

3) Sample extracts & minimal evidence: one week of recent telemetry (auth logs + admin activity + change-control entries), a sample access review (most recent), and a copy of the retention policy snapshot. Redactions are OK for PII.

4) Scope note: because Clarion migrated a subset of infra in Oct 2024, we need a short statement confirming whether the production workload Redwood will use was in-scope for the 2024 report or if it moved out/in at any time. If production workloads were out-of-scope at any time, ask for explicit coverage for the components that touch Redwood traffic.

Ben — please build the presigned S3 instruction text (short, copyable) and the bridge-letter template (one-paragraph) so we can send to Samir. I'll review and we can send both together.

Thanks,
